crossRefs.note: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with…
Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

parallels.note: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

people.name: Adoram
people.line: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon

people.name: Ahilud
people.line: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon

translations.web: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,
translations.bsb: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
translations.kjv: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
translations.asv: and Adoram was over the men subject to taskwork; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder;
